title: सप्ताधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 107 · The prince's refusal and the sage's reward

summary.en: The prince says that he will not live by deceit and fraud, and wishes to win only by the right means. The sage, pleased by his purity, gives him help, and he obtains his realm and the king's daughter.
summary.kn: ಮೋಸ, ವಂಚನೆಯಿಂದ ಬದುಕುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದಿಂದಲೇ ಗೆಲ್ಲಬೇಕೆಂದು ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಗೆ ಸಂತುಷ್ಟನಾದ ಋಷಿ ಸಹಾಯ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವನು ರಾಜ್ಯ, ರಾಜನ ಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: राजकुमार कहता है कि वह छल-कपट से नहीं जिएगा और केवल उचित साधनों से जीतना चाहता है। उसकी शुद्धता से प्रसन्न ऋषि उसकी सहायता करते हैं और वह राज्य तथा राजा की पुत्री पाता है।
summary.te: రాకుమారుడు మోసం, కపటంతో బతకనని, సరైన మార్గాలతోనే గెలవాలనుకుంటానని అంటాడు. అతని శుద్ధతకు సంతోషించిన ఋషి సహాయం చేయగా అతడు రాజ్యాన్ని, రాజు కుమార్తెను పొందుతాడు.
summary.ta: இளவரசன் வஞ்சகத்தாலும் ஏமாற்றாலும் வாழமாட்டேன், நேர்வழியிலேயே வெல்ல விரும்புகிறேன் என்கிறான். அவன் தூய்மையால் மகிழ்ந்த முனிவர் உதவ, அவன் நாட்டையும் மன்னனின் மகளையும் பெறுகிறான்.
summary.ml: വഞ്ചനയും കളവും കൊണ്ട് ജീവിക്കില്ലെന്ന് രാജകുമാരൻ പറയുന്നു; ശരിയായ മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങളിലൂടെ മാത്രം നേടാനാണ് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ആഗ്രഹം. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ശുദ്ധിയിൽ സന്തുഷ്ടനായ മുനി സഹായം നൽകുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹത്തിന് രാജ്യവും രാജപുത്രിയും ലഭിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.107; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: राजपुत्र उवाच

meaning.en: The prince said:

verses.text:
न निकृत्या न दम्भेन ब्रह्मन्निच्छामि जीवितुम् ।
नाधर्मयुक्तानिच्छेयमर्थान्सुमहतोऽप्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Brahmin, I do not wish to live by deceit or pretence; I would not want even very great wealth if tied to adharma.

verses.text:
पुरस्तादेव भगवन्मयैतदपवर्जितम् ।
येन मां नाभिशङ्केत यद्वा कृत्स्नं हितं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Long ago, venerable one, I gave this up, so that no one should suspect me and so that all may be for the good.

verses.text:
आनृशंस्येन धर्मेण लोके ह्यस्मिञ्जिजीविषुः ।
नाहमेतदलं कर्तुं नैतन्मय्युपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'Wishing to live in this world by the dharma of non-cruelty, I cannot do this; it does not suit me.'

verses.text: मुनिरुवाच

meaning.en: The sage said:

verses.text:
उपपन्नस्त्वमेतेन यथा क्षत्रिय भाषसे ।
प्रकृत्या ह्युपपन्नोऽसि बुद्ध्या चाद्भुतदर्शन ॥

meaning.en: 'You are endowed with what you say, Kshatriya; you are so by nature and by understanding, wonderful seer.

verses.text:
उभयोरेव वामर्थे यतिष्ये तव तस्य च ।
संश्लेषं वा करिष्यामि शाश्वतं ह्यनपायिनम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I shall strive for the good of both you and him, or I shall make a lasting bond between you that will not fail.

verses.text:
त्वादृशं हि कुले जातमनृशंसं बहुश्रुतम् ।
अमात्यं को न कुर्वीत राज्यप्रणयकोविदम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Who would not make a minister of one like you, born in a good family, merciful, learned, and skilled in guiding a kingdom?

verses.text:
यस्त्वं प्रव्रजितो राज्याद्व्यसनं चोत्तमं गतः ।
आनृशंस्येन वृत्तेन क्षत्रियेच्छसि जीवितुम् ॥

meaning.en: 'You, who went into exile from the kingdom and fell into extreme misfortune, still wish to live, Kshatriya, by a merciful way.

verses.text:
आगन्ता मद्गृहं तात वैदेहः सत्यसंगरः ।
यथाहं तं नियोक्ष्यामि तत्करिष्यत्यसंशयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'My son, the king of Videha, true to his word, will come to my house; I shall direct him, and he will surely do as I say.'

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
तत आहूय वैदेहं मुनिर्वचनमब्रवीत् ।
अयं राजकुले जातो विदिताभ्यन्तरो मम ॥

meaning.en: Then the sage summoned the king of Videha and said: 'This one, born in a royal house, is known to me inwardly.

verses.text:
आदर्श इव शुद्धात्मा शारदश्चन्द्रमा इव ।
नास्मिन्पश्यामि वृजिनं सर्वतो मे परीक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: 'Pure in spirit as a mirror, like the autumn moon; I see no fault in him, having tested him on every side.

verses.text:
तेन ते संधिरेवास्तु विश्वसास्मिन्यथा मयि ।
न राज्यमनमात्येन शक्यं शास्तुममित्रहन् ॥

meaning.en: 'So let there be a treaty with him; trust him as you trust me. A kingdom cannot be ruled without ministers, slayer of foes.

verses.text:
अमात्यः शूर एव स्याद्बुद्धिसंपन्न एव च ।
ताभ्यां चैव भयं राज्ञः पश्य राज्यस्य योजनम् ।
धर्मात्मनां क्वचिल्लोके नान्यास्ति गतिरीदृशी ॥

meaning.en: 'A minister should be brave and also endowed with wisdom; the king's fear and the kingdom's management depend on those two. For righteous men there is nowhere else in the world such a refuge.

verses.text:
कृतात्मा राजपुत्रोऽयं सतां मार्गमनुष्ठितः ।
सुसंगृहीतस्त्वेवैष त्वया धर्मपुरोगमः ।
संसेव्यमानः शत्रूंस्ते गृह्णीयान्महतो गणान् ॥

meaning.en: 'This prince is self-controlled and follows the path of the good. If you take him to yourself, with dharma foremost, then served by him he could seize great bands of your enemies.

verses.text:
यद्ययं प्रतियुध्येत्त्वां स्वकर्म क्षत्रियस्य तत् ।
जिगीषमाणस्त्वां युद्धे पितृपैतामहे पदे ॥

meaning.en: 'If he were to fight you, that is a Kshatriya's own deed, since he would be seeking to win you in war the seat of his father and grandfather.

verses.text:
त्वं चापि प्रतियुध्येथा विजिगीषुव्रते स्थितः ।
अयुद्ध्वैव नियोगान्मे वशे वैदेह ते स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: 'And you too might fight him, keeping to the vow of one who seeks to conquer; but at my bidding, king of Videha, he stands in your power without battle.

verses.text:
स त्वं धर्ममवेक्षस्व त्यक्त्वाधर्ममसांप्रतम् ।
न हि कामान्न च द्रोहात्स्वधर्मं हातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: 'So look to dharma and give up what is unfitting adharma; you should not abandon your own duty out of desire or malice.

verses.text:
नैव नित्यं जयस्तात नैव नित्यं पराजयः ।
तस्माद्भोजयितव्यश्च भोक्तव्यश्च परो जनः ॥

meaning.en: 'Victory is not always yours, my son, nor is defeat always; so the other man should be fed and also made to enjoy.

verses.text:
आत्मन्येव हि संदृश्यावुभौ जयपराजयौ ।
निःशेषकारिणां तात निःशेषकरणाद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Victory and defeat are both seen in oneself; those who do things thoroughly, my son, fear the thoroughness of what they do.'

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं वचनं ब्राह्मणर्षभम् ।
अभिपूज्याभिसत्कृत्य पूजार्हमनुमान्य च ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the king replied to the best of Brahmin sages, having honoured and revered him, worthy of reverence, and given him regard:

verses.text:
यथा ब्रूयान्महाप्राज्ञो यथा ब्रूयाद्बहुश्रुतः ।
श्रेयस्कामो यथा ब्रूयादुभयोर्यत्क्षमं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'As a very wise, much learned man who desires my good would speak, such as would be fitting to both...

verses.text:
तथा वचनमुक्तोऽस्मि करिष्यामि च तत्तथा ।
एतद्धि परमं श्रेयो न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: '...so have I been told, and so I shall do. This is the highest good, and I have no doubt about it.'

verses.text:
ततः कौसल्यमाहूय वैदेहो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
धर्मतो नीतितश्चैव बलेन च जितो मया ॥

meaning.en: Then the king of Videha summoned Kausalya and said: 'I was defeated by you through dharma, policy and strength.

verses.text:
सोऽहं त्वया त्वात्मगुणैर्जितः पार्थिवसत्तम ।
आत्मानमनवज्ञाय जितवद्वर्ततां भवान् ॥

meaning.en: 'I have been won over by you by your own qualities, best of kings; do not think little of yourself, and act as one who has won.

verses.text:
नावमन्ये च ते बुद्धिं नावमन्ये च पौरुषम् ।
नावमन्ये जयामीति जितवद्वर्ततां भवान् ॥

meaning.en: 'I do not despise your mind, nor your manliness; I do not despise you, so think 'I have won' and live as the victor.

verses.text:
यथावत्पूजितो राजन्गृहं गन्तासि मे गृहात् ।
ततः संपूज्य तौ विप्रं विश्वस्तौ जग्मतुर्गृहान् ॥

meaning.en: 'Honoured as is proper, king, you will go from my house to yours.' Then they honoured the Brahmin and went home trusting each other.

verses.text:
वैदेहस्त्वथ कौसल्यं प्रवेश्य गृहमञ्जसा ।
पाद्यार्घ्यमधुपर्कैस्तं पूजार्हं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Videha then promptly led Kausalya into his house and honoured him, worthy of honour, with foot-water, the arghya and honey-mixture.

verses.text:
ददौ दुहितरं चास्मै रत्नानि विविधानि च ।
एष राज्ञां परो धर्मः सह्यौ जयपराजयौ ॥

meaning.en: He gave him his daughter and many kinds of jewels. This is the highest dharma of kings: victory and defeat are both to be borne.
